choices.why: Its light pine top fits the Nordic light-wood brief, and the black pipe legs echo the black window frames; at 110 cm it suits the spot beside the window.
A comfortable padded swivel chair with a light oak frame and natural linen that matches the pine desk and the floor.
A tall white Nordic bookcase that blends into the white right-hand wall and keeps the room bright and airy.
A deep, soft armchair in light grey-beige, very comfortable for reading, with dark legs that tie in with the black accents.
A slim, adjustable reading lamp that aims light onto the book, and its black finish repeats the window frames and desk legs.

answer.why: Light wood, white and soft neutrals build a calm Nordic corner on the light floor, while the black details on the desk and lamp echo the window frames to tie the whole look together.
